Baked Sweet Potato Fries
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, March 2, 2010 - 11:13pm

Ingredients




nonstick spray coating
4 smalls sweet potatoes (about 1 lb)
1 -T margarine or butter, melted
1/4 -t seasoned salt
dash nutmeg

Preparation

1 Spray a 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan with nonstick coating. Scrub potatoes; cut lengthwise into quarters, then cut each quarter into 2 wedges. Arrange potatoes in a single layer in pan. 2 Combine margarine or butter, salt, and nutmeg. Brush onto potatoes. Bake in a 450 oven 20 minutes or until brown and tender.
